descriptionChirho: To lend money or goods to someone, used in the Qal stem for the basic act of making a loan.
To cause to lend or to extend a loan, the Hifil causative form emphasizing the granting of credit.
Substantivized participle denoting a creditor — one who has lent and holds a claim on the debtor, often with legal or social authority.
To exact payment or press demands upon debtors, emphasizing the oppressive or burdensome aspect of debt collection.
